name: Mortal Dynasty County Watershed
description: Two river-basin counties under Qingzhou Province linked by downstream watershed hydrology, sub-district venues, and multi-tier yamen governance. Spring sowing starts with last-season grain: 720 meal portions per anonymous resident, covering the 120-day crop period plus its preparation time. Initial grain is stored harvest from the previous season. Initial anonymous households hold 180 days of last-season rations (720 meal units/person at four meals/day), a finite six-month store covering the 120-day spring crop plus actual preparation, care and harvest delays; no automatic restocking.
